verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. Sing unto the LORD a new song, And His praise in the assembly of the saints.

verses.he: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.he: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let them praise His name in the dance; Let them sing praises unto Him with the timbrel and harp.

verses.he: כִּֽי־רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: For the LORD taketh pleasure in His people; He adorneth the humble with salvation.
Let the saints exult in glory; Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

verses.he: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
To execute vengeance upon the nations, And chastisements upon the peoples;

verses.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.he: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written;
